name: localthings
description: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.
one_liner: A free plugin that lets a smart-home system control Samsung washers, fridges, and other appliances directly over home WiFi, with no Samsung cloud account needed.
buyer: A smart-home installer who sets up Home Assistant systems for homeowners and wants reliable, privacy-respecting appliance control that doesn't break when the cloud is down.
business_use_cases: A smart-home installer adds 'full appliance integration' as a premium add-on when setting up Home Assistant for homeowners.
A short-term-rental property manager uses it to remotely check whether a unit's washer/dryer is running, for cleaning turnover scheduling, with no cloud subscription fee.
A privacy-focused smart-home consultant sells 'de-cloud your appliances' audits to homeowners worried about their data leaving the house.

money_ideas.idea: One-time installation and integration visit for homeowners
Ongoing smart-home maintenance retainer that includes it

steal_this: Offer local homeowners a one-time 'integrate your Samsung appliances into your smart home, no cloud needed' setup visit for a flat fee.
